units.source_text: 我开始考虑，要不要把自己一直犹豫不决的想法，统统告诉对方？

en.t: I began to wonder whether I should tell the other person all the thoughts I had been hesitating over.

units.source_text: 我说的对方并非指小姐，而是夫人。

en.t: By the other person, I did not mean the young lady, but her mother.

units.source_text: 我曾想过，是不是干脆跟夫人直截了当说，请你把小姐嫁给我吧。

en.t: I had thought of speaking plainly to her mother and asking her to let me marry the young lady.

units.source_text: 虽然这样下了决心，却又一天天拖延了下去。

en.t: Although I had made up my mind to do this, I kept putting it off day after day.

units.source_text: 如此看来，我真是个优柔寡断的人。

en.t: Seen in that light, I must have been a truly indecisive person.

units.source_text: 给人优柔寡断的感觉倒也罢了，真正使我犹豫不决的，并不是由于缺乏胆量。

en.t: It would not matter if I seemed indecisive, but what really made me hesitate was not a lack of courage.

units.source_text: 在K没搬来的时候，我是怕落入人家的圈套，因此一再压抑自己，一步也不能往前迈进。

en.t: Before K moved in, I was afraid of falling into someone else's trap, so I kept suppressing myself and could not take even one step forward.

units.source_text: K来了以后，我又怀疑小姐是否喜欢K，这一疑心制约了我。

en.t: After K came, I began to suspect that the young lady might like him, and that suspicion held me back.

units.source_text: 因为我暗下决心，倘若小姐倾心的真是K，而不是我的话，

en.t: For I had secretly resolved that if the young lady's heart truly belonged to K and not to me,

units.source_text: 我就没有必要表达自己的爱慕之心了，这跟一般人说的害怕丢面子可不是一回事。

en.t: then there would be no need for me to confess my love, and this was not the same as the ordinary fear of losing face.

units.source_text: 无论我这边多么喜欢对方，如果对方心里想的是另外一个人的话，我也不愿意同那样的女人生活在一起。

en.t: No matter how much I loved her, if her heart was set on another man, I did not want to live with such a woman.

units.source_text: 世上的确有那种不管人家是否愿意，非要把自己喜欢的那个女人娶回家，而且沾沾自喜的人。

en.t: There are indeed people in the world who insist on marrying the woman they love regardless of her wishes, and even feel pleased with themselves for it.

units.source_text: 当时，我认为这种人不是比我们更世故的人，就是不懂得爱是何物的蠢人。

en.t: At the time, I thought such people were either more worldly than we were or fools who did not understand what love was.

units.source_text: 我那时候年轻气盛，以至于连一旦娶回家，便一切都尘埃落定这么浅显的道理都不懂得。

en.t: I was so young and impetuous then that I did not even understand the simple truth that once a woman was married into the household, everything would settle down.

units.source_text: 总之，我是个极为高尚的爱情理论家，同时又是个最最迂腐的爱情实践者。

en.t: In short, I was an exceedingly noble theorist of love, and at the same time the most hopelessly impractical practitioner of it.
